气压带、风带与三圈环流 · 3D 互动课件: Pressure Belts, Wind Belts and the Three-Cell Circulation · 3D Interactive Lesson
人教版选择性必修 1 · 第三章第二节「气压带和风带」（p.48–53），第三节: PEP Geography Elective Required Book 1 · Ch. 3 Sec. 2 "Pressure Belts and Wind Belts" (pp.48–53), Sec. 3 case study (pp.56–57)
气压带、风带与三圈环流: Pressure Belts, Wind Belts and the Three-Cell Circulation
麦哲伦船队为什么有的航段逆风、有的顺风，到了 30°S 附近却寸步难行？: Why did Magellan's fleet face headwinds on some legs and tailwinds on others, yet barely move near 30°S?
赤道受热上升 → 赤道低压带: Equator heated, air rises → equatorial low
30° 堆积下沉 · 60° 暖空气爬升 → 三圈: Piles up and sinks at 30° · warm air climbs at 60° → three cells
七个气压带 · 六个风带 · 绕地一圈: Seven pressure belts · six wind belts · each circles the globe
随直射点夏北冬南 → 交替控制: Follow the subsolar point north in summer, south in winter → alternating control
陆地冬冷夏热 → 气压中心 → 季风: Land cold in winter, hot in summer → pressure centers → monsoons
0°–30°：赤道上升 · 30° 下沉: 0°–30°: rising at the equator · sinking at 30°
60°–90°：60° 爬升 · 极地下沉: 60°–90°: climbing at 60° · sinking at the pole
赤道为什么是一条低压带？: Why is the equator a belt of low pressure?
拖动视角绕地球看一圈：剖面里，赤道上空的琥珀色箭头往上升: Drag the view around the globe: in the cross-section, the amber arrows above the equator rise
赤道近地面的空气受热上升，剖面里低纬环流的上升支（琥珀色）从赤道升起: Near-surface air at the equator is heated and rises; in the cross-section the rising branch of the Hadley cell (amber) goes up from the equator
受热不均 + 地转偏向力 → 大气环流: Uneven heating + Coriolis force → atmospheric circulation
教材假设：地球表面是均匀的: Textbook assumption: Earth's surface is uniform
赤道地区接受太阳辐射能量多，近地面空气受热膨胀上升，空气密度减小，气压降低。: The equatorial region receives more solar radiation; near-surface air is heated, expands and rises, its density falls and the pressure drops.
教材假设地球表面是均匀的：引起大气运动的只有高、低纬度的受热不均和地转偏向力。: The textbook assumes a uniform Earth surface: the only causes of atmospheric motion are uneven heating between high and low latitudes and the Coriolis force.
赤道低压带是热力成因：由冷热差异直接造成。: The equatorial low has a thermal origin: it is caused directly by the temperature difference.
去掉这一步：不知道大气为什么会动起来，后面的三个环流圈都无从谈起。: Skip this step and you don't know why the atmosphere moves at all, so the three circulation cells can't be explained.
常考：赤道低压带、极地高压带是热力成因；副热带高压带、副极地低压带是动力成因。: Often tested: the equatorial low and polar high are thermal in origin; the subtropical high and subpolar low are dynamic in origin.
赤道接受的太阳辐射多，近地面空气受热膨胀上升、气压降低，形成赤道低压带（热力成因: The equator receives more solar radiation; near-surface air is heated, expands and rises and the pressure drops, forming the equatorial low-pressure belt (thermal origin).
升上去的空气，为什么走到 30° 就下沉？: Why does air that has risen sink when it reaches 30°?
点一下剖面（或环流圈），从赤道上空放出一团空气，看它在高空一边向北走、一边向右偏: Click the cross-section (or a cell) to release a parcel of air above the equator, and watch it move north aloft while veering right
气团先偏成西南风，到 30°N 高空偏成西风，在那里堆积下沉；虚线是「如果不偏转: The parcel first veers into a southwest wind, becomes a westerly aloft at 30°N, and piles up and sinks there; the dashed line is the path it would take "without deflection", flowing all the way to the pole
地转偏向力：北半球右偏 · 南半球左偏 · 赤道不偏: Coriolis force: right in the Northern Hemisphere · left in the Southern · none at the equator
30°N 高空：气流偏成西风 → 堆积下沉: Aloft at 30°N: flow veers into a westerly → piles up and sinks
赤道上升的暖空气在高空向南北分流；向北的一支逐渐右偏成西南风，到北纬 30° 附: Warm air rising at the equator splits north and south aloft; the northward branch gradually veers right into a southwest wind and becomes a westerly aloft near 30°N.
空气在这里不断堆积下沉，使地面气压升高，形成副热带高压带（动力成因）。: Air keeps piling up and sinking here, raising the surface pressure and forming the subtropical high-pressure belt (dynamic origin).
下沉后近地面分两支：向南右偏成东北信风，向北右偏成西南风（盛行西风）；东北信风与: After sinking it splits into two branches near the surface: southward it veers right into the northeast trades, northward it veers right into southwest winds (the prevailing westerlies); the northeast and southeast trades converge and rise at the equator.
去掉偏转：气流会一路流到极地（虚线），不会在 30° 附近堆积下沉，也就没有副热: Without deflection, the flow would go all the way to the pole (dashed line) without piling up and sinking near 30°, and there would be no subtropical high.
易错：副热带高压带不是冷却下沉形成的，是高空气流堆积下沉（动力成因）。: Common mistake: the subtropical high isn't formed by cooling and sinking; it's upper-level air piling up and sinking (dynamic origin).
地转偏向力让高空气流在 30° 附近偏成西风，空气堆积下沉，形成副热带高压带；东: The Coriolis force turns upper-level flow into a westerly near 30°, where air piles up and sinks to form the subtropical high; the northeast and southeast trades converge and rise at the equator, forming the Hadley cell.
60° 附近为什么又出现一条低压带？: Why is there another belt of low pressure near 60°?
点剖面里 60°N 的「极锋」: Click the "polar front" at 60°N in the cross-section
暖而轻的盛行西风沿极锋爬升到冷而重的极地东风之上；中纬、高纬两个环流圈闭合，中纬: Warm, light prevailing westerlies climb along the polar front over the cold, heavy polar easterlies; the Ferrel and polar cells close, and the Ferrel cell turns in the opposite direction to the other two
暖而轻的盛行西风 → 爬升到冷而重的极地东风之上: Warm, light prevailing westerlies → climb over the cold, heavy polar easterlies
北极终年寒冷，空气堆积下沉，形成极地高压带；向南流的气流右偏成东北风，叫极地东风: The Arctic is cold all year, so air piles up and sinks, forming the polar high; flow heading south veers right into a northeast wind, the polar easterlies.
极地东风在北纬 60° 附近与较暖的盛行西风相遇，暖空气爬升，在两条高压带之间形: Near 60°N the polar easterlies meet the warmer prevailing westerlies and the warm air climbs, forming a relatively low-pressure belt between the two high-pressure belts: the subpolar low (dynamic origin).
低纬环流、高纬环流由冷热差异直接驱动；中纬环流夹在中间被带动，方向与两侧相反。: The Hadley and polar cells are driven directly by temperature differences; the Ferrel cell between them is dragged along and turns the opposite way.
去掉这一步：中纬、高纬两个环流圈都不成立，北半球只剩一个低纬环流圈。: Skip this step and neither the Ferrel nor the polar cell exists; the Northern Hemisphere would have only the Hadley cell.
易错：副极地低压带不是受热上升形成的，是冷暖气流相遇、暖空气爬升（动力成因）。: Common mistake: the subpolar low isn't formed by heated air rising; it's warm air climbing where cold and warm air meet (dynamic origin).
暖空气沿极锋爬升，形成副极地低压带（动力成因）；北半球由此有三个环流圈，南半球同: Warm air climbs along the polar front to form the subpolar low (dynamic origin); so the Northern Hemisphere has three circulation cells, and so does the Southern.
facts-补 A1.2 第 6–8 条（教材 p.49）；旧 facts A2: facts supplement A1.2 items 6–8 (textbook p.49); old facts A2.1, direct / indirect nature of the cells
七个气压带、六个风带，是一条线还是绕地球一圈？: Seven pressure belts and six wind belts: are they lines, or do they circle the globe?
点一下剖面，让它绕地轴扫一圈；再在球面上点一个风带的箭头: Click the cross-section to sweep it around Earth's axis, then click a wind-belt arrow on the globe
剖面绕地轴扫一圈，在球面留下 7 条环带；点中的风带先画「本该的方向」（由高压指: The cross-section sweeps around the axis, leaving 7 bands on the globe; the selected wind belt first shows "where it would blow" (from high to low pressure), then turns to its deflected direction
判风向：① 由高压指向低压 ② 北半球右偏、南半球左偏: Finding wind direction: ① from high to low pressure ② right in the Northern Hemisphere, left in the Southern
气压带、风带都是绕地球一圈的环带，不是一条线；风带是一个纬度范围里的盛行风。: Pressure and wind belts are bands circling the globe, not lines; a wind belt is the prevailing wind over a range of latitudes.
北半球：低纬信风带吹东北风，中纬西风带吹西南风（盛行西风），极地东风带吹东北风。: Northern Hemisphere: the trade wind belt blows northeast winds, the westerly belt southwest winds (prevailing westerlies), the polar easterly belt northeast winds.
南半球镜像：东南信风、西北风（盛行西风）、东南风（极地东风）。: Southern Hemisphere mirror: southeast trades, northwest winds (prevailing westerlies), southeast winds (polar easterlies).
去掉这一步：只会背一张剖面图，说不出风向为什么是斜的。: Skip this step and students can only memorize a cross-section diagram, unable to say why wind directions are oblique.
常考：判风向先画由高压指向低压，再按北半球右偏、南半球左偏；「西风」指从西往东吹: Often tested: to find wind direction, first draw from high to low pressure, then deflect right in the north and left in the south; "westerly" means wind blowing from west to east.
带是绕地球一圈的环。全球 7 个气压带、6 个风带；风向由高压指向低压，再按北半: The belts are rings around the globe: 7 pressure belts and 6 wind belts worldwide; wind blows from high to low pressure, then deflects right in the north and left in the south.
facts-补 A1.2 第 8–9 条（教材 p.49、图 3.10）；旧 f: facts supplement A1.2 items 8–9 (textbook p.49, Fig. 3.10); old facts A2.3
直射点北移以后，罗马的夏天为什么变干？: After the subsolar point moves north, why does Rome's summer become dry?
把月份从 4 月拖到 7 月，盯住罗马（红点）和中控台的罗马读数: Drag the month from April to July and watch Rome (red dot) and the Rome reading on the console
直射点 9.7°N → 21.6°N，带系平移 +4.1° → +9.2°，副高: Subsolar point 9.7°N → 21.6°N, belt shift +4.1° → +9.2°, subtropical high (north) center 34.1°N → 39.2°N; Rome switches from the westerly belt to control by the subtropical high
直射点北移 → 气压带、风带整体北移: Subsolar point moves north → pressure and wind belts shift north together
移动幅度 10° 为课件设定（示意）: The 10° shift amplitude is a lesson setting (schematic)
由于太阳直射点的南北移动，气压带和风带在一年内做周期性的季节移动。: Because the subsolar point moves north and south, the pressure and wind belts shift seasonally over the year.
在北半球，与二分日相比，气压带和风带的位置大致是夏季偏北、冬季偏南。: In the Northern Hemisphere, compared with the equinoxes, the pressure and wind belts lie roughly farther north in summer and farther south in winter.
纬度 30°—40° 的大陆西部，夏季受副热带高压带控制、炎热干燥，冬季受西风带: On the western side of continents at 30°–40° latitude, summer is controlled by the subtropical high (hot and dry) and winter by the westerlies (mild and rainy), giving a Mediterranean climate.
去掉这一步：解释不了罗马夏冬降水为什么差这么多（6–8 月 95.8 mm，12: Skip this step and you can't explain why Rome's summer and winter rainfall differ so much (June–August 95.8 mm; December, January, February 229.7 mm).
易错：季节移动是整个带系一起平移，不是「北半球的带跑到北边去」；地中海气候是夏干: Common mistake: the seasonal shift moves the whole belt system together, not "the northern belts running north"; the Mediterranean climate has dry summers and wet winters, not rain all year.
气压带、风带随直射点移动，北半球夏季偏北、冬季偏南；罗马夏季受副热带高压带控制、: Pressure and wind belts follow the subsolar point, lying farther north in the Northern Hemisphere summer and farther south in winter; Rome is under the subtropical high in summer and the westerlies in winter, giving a Mediterranean climate with dry summers and wet winters.
facts-补 A1.4、A1.8 第 3–4 条（教材 p.50、p.56–5: facts supplement A1.4, A1.8 items 3–4 (textbook p.50, pp.56–57); old facts B2.1 reference table, April and July rows
1 月的亚洲，为什么出现一个巨大的高压？: Why does a huge high-pressure system appear over Asia in January?
把月份从 7 月拖到 1 月，看亚欧大陆上的气压中心怎样换: Drag the month from July to January and watch how the pressure centers over Eurasia change
7 月：亚洲低压（印度低压，996 hPa）切断副热带高压带，副高只留在海洋上；: July: the Asian low (Indian low, 996 hPa) cuts through the subtropical high, which remains only over the oceans; January: the Asian high (Siberian high, 1036 hPa) cuts through the subpolar low, which remains only over the oceans
理想模式 + 海陆热力差异 = 实际气压分布: Ideal model + land–sea thermal contrast = actual pressure distribution
冬季陆地降温快 → 冷高压；夏季陆地增温快 → 热低压: In winter land cools faster → cold high; in summer land warms faster → thermal low
冬季陆地降温比海洋快，出现冷高压；夏季陆地增温比海洋快，出现热低压。: In winter land cools faster than the ocean, producing a cold high; in summer land warms faster than the ocean, producing a thermal low.
北半球陆地面积大、海陆相间，纬向的气压带被分裂为一个个高、低气压中心；南半球 3: The Northern Hemisphere has large land areas alternating with ocean, so the zonal pressure belts break up into separate high and low pressure centers; south of 30°S the Southern Hemisphere stays largely banded.
气压中心的季节变化使盛行风向随季节变换，形成季风：东亚冬季吹西北季风，夏季吹东南: Seasonal changes in the pressure centers make prevailing winds change with the seasons, forming monsoons: East Asia has northwest monsoons in winter and southeast monsoons in summer.
去掉这一步：会以为真实地球上的气压就是一条条整齐的带。: Skip this step and students think pressure on the real Earth is a set of neat belts.
常考：1 月北半球副极地低压带被大陆冷高压切断，7 月副热带高压带被大陆热低压切: Often tested: in January the Northern Hemisphere subpolar low is cut by continental cold highs; in July the subtropical high is cut by continental thermal lows.
海陆热力差异使北半球纬向的气压带被分裂成高、低气压中心：1 月亚洲高压切断副极地: Land–sea thermal contrast breaks the Northern Hemisphere's zonal pressure belts into high and low centers: in January the Asian high cuts the subpolar low, in July the Asian low cuts the subtropical high; the centers change with the seasons, forming monsoons.
facts-补 A1.6、A1.7、A2（教材 p.50–52、图 3.12–3: facts supplement A1.6, A1.7, A2 (textbook pp.50–52, Figs. 3.12–3.14)
考核：麦哲伦船队的四段航程，各受哪个带控制？: Assessment: which belt controlled each of the four legs of Magellan's voyage?
按左栏题目，依次在球面上点出每段航程所在的带（考核按 3 月接近春分的带位 ·: Following the questions in the left column, click the belt each leg lies in on the globe (the assessment uses March belt positions, near the equinox · setting)
南美洲南端的海峡：盛行西风（逆风）；30°S 附近：副热带高压带（平静无风）；东: The strait at the southern tip of South America: prevailing westerlies (headwind); near 30°S: subtropical high (calm); the southeast-wind leg: southeast trades (tailwind); near the equator: equatorial low (calm seas)
考核按 3 月（接近春分）的带位 · 设定: The assessment uses March belt positions (near the equinox) · setting
南美洲南端的海峡受盛行西风影响，船队向西逆风航行。: The strait at the southern tip of South America is under the prevailing westerlies, so the fleet sailing west faced headwinds.
30°S 附近受副热带高压带控制，气流下沉，平静无风，天气炎热，航行十分艰难。: Near 30°S the subtropical high controls; air sinks, it's calm and hot, and sailing was very hard.
进入东南信风带后顺风航行，最为轻松；到赤道附近，受赤道低压带控制，风平浪静。: Once in the southeast trade wind belt the fleet sailed with the wind, the easiest leg; near the equator, under the equatorial low, the seas were calm.
去掉这一步：学了带的分布，却不会拿它解释一段真实的航程。: Skip this step and students know the distribution of belts but can't use it to explain a real voyage.
常考：给一条航线或一个地点，判断所在的气压带、风带，再说出风况或天气。: Often tested: given a route or place, identify its pressure belt and wind belt, then describe the wind or weather.
盛行西风 → 逆风；副热带高压带 → 平静无风；东南信风 → 顺风；赤道低压带: Prevailing westerlies → headwind; subtropical high → calm; southeast trades → tailwind; equatorial low → calm seas.
facts-补 A1.1、B3（教材 p.48、p.50）: facts supplement A1.1, B3 (textbook p.48, p.50)
高空：右偏成西南风: Aloft: veers right into a southwest wind
30°N 高空：偏成西风 → 堆积下沉: Aloft at 30°N: veers into a westerly → piles up and sinks
如果不偏转：一路流到极地: Without deflection: all the way to the pole
本该：北风（由高压指向低压）→ 右偏成东北信风: Would be: north wind (high to low) → veers right into the northeast trades
本该：南风 → 右偏成西南风（盛行西风）: Would be: south wind → veers right into southwest winds (prevailing westerlies)
本该：北风 → 右偏成东北风（极地东风）: Would be: north wind → veers right into northeast winds (polar easterlies)
本该：南风 → 左偏成东南信风: Would be: south wind → veers left into the southeast trades
本该：北风 → 左偏成西北风（盛行西风）: Would be: north wind → veers left into northwest winds (prevailing westerlies)
